### **Hi there!**

I am a student at Chaminade University studying Computer Science and Data Science. This website serves as both a personal get to know me and an overview into the projects that I have created so far.

### **Featured Project**

**Mokuoloe Dashboard**

I built this dashboard using Python and it displays the data analysis I worked on during a summer internship. The data is centered around sea level rise and extreme water level events on Coconut Island (near the east side of Oahu). Visit the [Mokuoloe Dashboard](mokuoloe.qmd) page for more info!
